method: Actual browser playback and selected rendered video frames. No game installation, no copied assets, no claim of continuous full-video review or measured gait timing.

observations.viewed: Selected frames in preceding integration session: 0:52 bow aim, 1:44 landscape, 2:57 skills menu; brief playback.
observations.element: Clothing, bow posture, camp, terrain, menu
observations.details: Hood and layered leather shoulder mantle; bracers; drawing hand near face and elbow outside torso. Palisade, steps and canvas canopy form a coherent camp. Skills menu uses radial nodes over a muted background.
observations.decision: Create one layered original travelling outfit with readable garment construction; evaluate draw elbow and shoulder silhouette from front/side/rear. Keep menu hierarchy compact.

observations.viewed: Official Bethesda trailer played briefly; actual frames at 0:37 and 0:51 inspected.
observations.element: Landscape composition, armour layers and bow grip
observations.details: Lake shoreline meets rocky ground and conifers of several sizes; mountains are a distant layer. Bow close-up shows separate engraved bracer, exposed hand, shoulder armour and torso straps; background actor has a distinct armour silhouette.
observations.decision: Separate skin, cloth and leather/metal material response; use cuffs/bracers and garment layers that follow the rig. Preserve foreground/midground/distant terrain structure.

observations.viewed: Official developer press page, screenshot thumbnails and selected launch trailer playback; paused actual frame 0:44.
observations.element: Visible physical consequence and group silhouettes
observations.details: A carried body hangs across another character; equipped characters form a group on sparse rough ground. Press gallery includes crafting, farms, carrying wounded and settlement screenshots, but only thumbnails were visible.
observations.decision: NPC tasks must be expressed by actual object/pose use and persistent consequences. Carry/work actions require separate authored poses; do not infer robust AI from a trailer frame.

observations.viewed: Trailer linked by official repository, brief playback and actual frame 1:05 inspected.
observations.element: Conversation presentation in an inhabited interior
observations.details: Hooded NPC faces player near a timber doorway, with hall furniture/fire behind; response is presented as bottom subtitles rather than floating activity text over the head.
observations.decision: Keep local contextual dialogue in the world, preserve NPC identity and action memory; no mandatory paid API and no voice implementation in this phase.

current_impuls_art_findings: Existing two MakeHuman body meshes are integrated in the review branch, but owner acceptance is explicitly false.
Current live garment source is male_casualsuit01 for both bodies: a modern-style shirt/trouser suit. Changing its tint cannot produce a complete fantasy wardrobe.
Physically present selected MakeHuman clothes directories are male_casualsuit01, shoes01 and shoes03; this selected pack contains no ready layered medieval outfit.
Existing rendered edge views show plain torso, weak garment separation and sparse hair silhouette. These are appearance defects, independently of passing sole support tests.
No model, texture, runtime material or animation was replaced during this reference audit.

next_connected_art_batch.target: One coherent original clothed human family, both bodies, with properly fitted tunic/layers, belt and footwear, followed by the existing movement/combat/editor/save scenarios.
requirements: Inspect any additional existing clothing packs before choosing or generating geometry.
Keep all nine synchronized shape keys and skin weights; do not replace hands with rigid props.
Evaluate shoulders, cuffs, waist and knees across idle/walk/run/jump/bow/axe/cast, all sides.
Compare actual game lighting and close-up views, and record failed candidates.

open_reference_work: Several representative frames per category and continuous movement sequences remain required; the four games being opened is not completion of the full reference specification.
